title: Pure The Agents
match: The Sacred Waters in the Sky
summary: Pure The Agents LIGHT and DARK Fairy Synchro and Link strategy revolving around planetary emissaries, Master Hyperion, and the celestial sanctuary. Through explosive swarming via The Agent of Creation - Venus and The Agent of Destruction - Venus, the deck generates dozens of Fairy bodies to fuel Masterflare Hyperion and lock down the field under The Sanctuary in the Sky.

summary.title: Starters
points: The Agent of Creation - Venus pays 500 LP without once-per-turn limit to Special Summon Mystical Shine Ball from your hand or Deck, instantly converting 1 Normal Summon into 4 Fairy bodies.

The Agent of Destruction - Venus banishes The Agent of Creation - Venus from your GY to Special Summon itself from hand as a Tuner, then pays multiples of 500 LP to revive up to 3 Mystical Shine Balls from your GY or banishment.
The Agent of Mystery - Earth searches any The Agent monster from your Deck on Normal Summon, or searches Master Hyperion if The Sanctuary in the Sky is on the field or in your GY.
The Sacred Waters in the Sky activates The Sanctuary in the Sky directly from your Deck or adds 1 monster mentioning it to your hand, and heals LP for each Hyperion and Agent on your field.
The Agent of Life - Neptune discards itself to Special Summon an Agent or Hyperion from your hand or GY, and searches The Sanctuary in the Sky when banished.

summary.title: Opening: Creation - Venus + The Sacred Waters in the Sky
steps: Activate The Sacred Waters in the Sky to place The Sanctuary in the Sky directly into your Field Zone.
Normal Summon The Agent of Creation - Venus and pay 1500 LP to Special Summon 3 copies of Mystical Shine Ball from your Deck.
Link Summon Protector of The Agents - Moon using 2 Mystical Shine Balls, sending The Agent of Life - Neptune from your Deck to the GY.
Link Summon Celestial Knightlord Parshath using Venus and Moon, discarding a card to search The Agent of Destruction - Venus.
Banish Creation - Venus to Special Summon Destruction - Venus, pay 1500 LP to revive all 3 Mystical Shine Balls, and tune into Masterflare Hyperion.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Masterflare Hyperion sends an Agent monster or monster mentioning The Sanctuary in the Sky from your hand, Deck, or Extra Deck to the GY once per turn to copy its name and effects, and banishes a Fairy from hand or GY as a Quick Effect to banish 1 card on the field when the opponent activates an effect.
Master Hyperion banishes an Agent from hand, field, or GY to summon itself, and banishes a LIGHT Fairy from GY to destroy 1 card on the field.

Majesty Hyperion banishes an Agent from hand, field, or GY to summon itself from hand or GY, banishes a Fairy to banish a card from either GY, and inflicts reflective battle damage from Fairy battles to the opponent.
The Executor of the Underworld - Pluto is treated as The Sanctuary in the Sky on field and in GY, and banishes a Fairy from GY as a Quick Effect to flip an opponent's effect monster face-down.
Chaos Angel banishes a card on the field upon Synchro Summon and grants battle and monster effect immunity when summoned using LIGHT and DARK Fairies.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: The Sanctuary in the Sky reduces all battle damage you take from Fairy battles to 0 and unlocks the maximum potential of all Agent and Hyperion effects.
Fallen Sanctuary activates The Sanctuary in the Sky or a card mentioning it from Deck or GY on activation, and banishes a card from GY as a Quick Effect to negate an opponent's effect monster.
The Chorus in the Sky pays 1000 LP to add a Fairy monster from your GY to your hand.

allow.Mystical Shine Ball: Core Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Normal Monster (500 ATK / 500 DEF) Special Summoned up to 3 times by The Agent of Creation - Venus and revived up to 3 more times by The Agent of Destruction - Venus for Synchro and Link climbing!
allow.Diviner of the Herald: Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Tuner that sends a Fairy from your Deck/Extra Deck to the GY to modulate its Level and climb into Masterflare Hyperion or Chaos Angel.
allow.The Executor of the Underworld - Pluto: Level 5 DARK Fairy Synchro Tuner treated as 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' on the field/GY that banishes 1 Fairy from your GY as a Quick Effect to flip an Effect Monster on the field face-down!
allow.Celestial Knightlord Parshath: Link-3 LIGHT Fairy summoned using Venus + Mystical Shine Balls that discards 1 card to search The Sanctuary in the Sky or any Fairy monster while Sanctuary is on the field!
allow.Chaos Angel: Level 10 Synchro boss summoned using LIGHT and DARK Agents/Hyperions (treating any LIGHT or DARK monster as a Tuner!) that banishes a card on Summon and grants battle and monster effect protection.

main: The Agent of Creation - Venus

Core 1-card combo starter (Level 3 LIGHT Fairy): pays 500 LP (not once per turn!) to Special Summon 1 'Mystical Shine Ball' from your hand or Deck—turning 1 Normal Summon into 4 Fairy bodies on the board!
The Agent of Destruction - Venus

Level 3 DARK Fairy Tuner: banishes 'The Agent of Creation - Venus' from your GY to Special Summon itself from your hand, then pays multiples of 500 LP to Special Summon up to 3 'Mystical Shine Balls' from your GY and/or banishment!
The Agent of Mystery - Earth
Core Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Tuner: when Normal Summoned, adds any 'The Agent' monster (except Earth) from your Deck to your hand—or adds 'Master Hyperion' if 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' is on the field!
The Agent of Life - Neptune

Level 1 LIGHT Fairy: discards itself from your hand to Special Summon 1 'The Agent' monster from your hand or GY (or a 'Hyperion' monster if Sanctuary is on the field/GY!); and searches 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' when banished!
Master Hyperion

Signature Level 8 LIGHT Fairy boss (2700 ATK): Special Summons itself from your hand by banishing 1 'The Agent' monster from your hand, field, or GY (triggering Neptune!); once per turn (or twice per turn while Sanctuary is on the field!) banishes 1 LIGHT Fairy from your GY to destroy 1 card on the field!
Majesty Hyperion

Level 8 DARK Fairy boss (2100 ATK / 2700 DEF): banishes 1 'The Agent' monster from your hand, field, or GY to Special Summon itself from your hand OR GY; banishes a Fairy from your hand/GY to banish a card from either GY and makes your opponent also take any battle damage you take from Fairy battles!
Mystical Shine Ball
Summoned up to 6 times per turn across Creation - Venus and Destruction - Venus to assemble Link-2 Moon, Link-3 Parshath, Level 5 Pluto, and Level 10 Masterflare Hyperion!
Diviner of the Herald
Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Tuner that dumps The Agent of Life - Neptune or a Fairy from Deck to GY to adjust its Level and set up revivals.
The Sacred Waters in the Sky

Core Spell: activates 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' directly from your Deck OR adds 1 monster that mentions 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' (Venus, Earth, Neptune, or Hyperion!) from your Deck to your hand, and gains 500 LP per Hyperion/Agent if Sanctuary is on the field/GY!
The Chorus in the Sky
Pays 1000 LP to target 1 Fairy monster in your GY (or 1 banished Fairy if Sanctuary is on the field/GY!) and add it to your hand.
The Sanctuary in the Sky
Iconic Field Spell activated from Deck by Sacred Waters and Fallen Sanctuary that reduces all battle damage you take from Fairy battles to 0 and unlocks all bonus Agent/Hyperion effects.
Fallen Sanctuary

Signature Continuous Trap: activates 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' or a Spell/Trap that mentions it directly from your Deck or GY on activation; and banishes 1 card from your GY as a Quick Effect to negate the effects of 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls!
extra: Signature Level 10 LIGHT Fairy Synchro boss (1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Fairy monsters; 3200 ATK): once per turn sends 1 'The Agent' monster or 1 monster that mentions 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' (like Creation - Venus!) from your hand, Deck, or Extra Deck to the GY to copy its name and effects; and when your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect), banishes 1 Fairy from your hand/GY to banish 1 card on the field!
The Executor of the Underworld - Pluto

Signature Level 5 DARK Fairy Synchro Tuner (Level 3 Creation/Destruction - Venus + Level 2 Mystical Shine Ball): treated as 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' while on the field or in the GY; banishes 1 Fairy from your GY (Quick Effect if Sanctuary is up!) to flip 1 Effect Monster on the field into face-down Defense Position; and banishes itself from GY to search 'The Sanctuary in the Sky'!

Signature Link-2 LIGHT Fairy (2 Fairy monsters): sends 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' or 1 card that mentions it (Majesty Hyperion or The Agent of Life - Neptune!) from your Deck to the GY on Link Summon, and tributes 1 Fairy you control to destroy 1 card your opponent controls!
Link-3 LIGHT Fairy (2+ Fairy monsters) that discards 1 card to search The Sacred Waters in the Sky or Fallen Sanctuary.

Level 10 Synchro boss (easily summoned using Level 2 Mystical Shine Ball + Level 8 Master/Majesty Hyperion, or Level 5 Pluto + Level 3 Venus + Level 2 Shine Ball!) that banishes a card on Summon and grants both LIGHT and DARK protection!
